name: chalk
note: Tiny long-lived JS library (~35 files): index.js -> source/, media/ and examples/ appear; quick smoke test and baseline.

name: express
note: Mid-size library over 15 years (~3.9k commits, ~216 files): early lib/ reorganization, branch merges with many renames, examples/*/app.js -> index.js wave; long history at modest width.

name: vue-core
note: TypeScript monorepo (~6.6k commits, ~700 files): packages/* appear and get renamed (e05673f), private packages move to packages-private/ (6a5b209); widest and longest real fixture.

name: ripgrep
note: Rust workspace: top-level sub-crates (globset/, ignore/, grep/...) all moved under crates/ in fdd8510 (2020): a real-world mass directory move in a small tree.

name: synth-explode
note: 70 quiet commits on a ~70-file tree, then src/net/handlers/ gains 2-5 files per commit to ~660 files: one mid-tree directory explodes and pushes its neighbours. Generated by scripts/synth.ts (deterministic shas).

name: synth-massmove
note: Steady growth, then whole-directory moves (lib/ -> src/lib/, test/ -> src/test/, bin/ -> tools/bin/), a 3-batch .js -> .ts rename refactor, a dir split and a flatten (~700 exact/near renames). Generated by scripts/synth.ts (deterministic shas).

name: synth-churn
note: ~150 live files with constant add/delete turnover (1-6 per commit) and rotating directories: size stays flat while identity churns; tests ghost/reuse policies. Generated by scripts/synth.ts (deterministic shas).

name: synth-alphabet
note: Name-order adversary: every new file and directory gets a name that sorts before all existing siblings, so name-ordered layouts shift on every insert. Generated by scripts/synth.ts (deterministic shas).

name: synth-deep
note: Growth by nesting: a few chains go one level deeper every few commits (max depth 30), with files at random depths and side chains branching off. Generated by scripts/synth.ts (deterministic shas).
